title: 第1347章 你是去当一个反派的第1346章 你再去拜其他人为师吧
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
噗通…！
听到青墨让自己去拜他人为师，以为对方不要自己的时候，眼中满是慌乱无措的罗睺，立刻就跪倒在了前者的面前！
“师尊！师尊！”
“弟子是做错什么事了吗？弟子一定会潜心悔改，往后更加遵从师尊教诲！”
“师尊！您别不要弟子啊！”
话落！
记得都快哭出来的小正太罗睺，他连忙对着青墨不停磕头，语气里尽是哀求与颤抖！
这些年青墨作为罗睺的师尊，可谓事事都替这个徒弟着想，不管是用的还是练的，都是顶级中的顶级！
而且每次罗睺在修炼时遇到不解之处，青墨也都耐心的为他解惑提点，甚至反复教导多次，生怕他不能一下子领悟精髓！
身为师父的青墨，他对罗睺的好，后者完全是看在眼里，记在心里，一刻不敢忘记！
如今对自己如此之好的师尊，居然要让他拜他人为师！
这种事情对于罗睺来说，无异于天塌了一样！
“快起来，快起来！”
“谁说为师不要你了？！”
看着眼前情绪激动万分的罗睺，青墨微微一笑，当即弯腰伸手将他扶起，并且还轻轻拍打其跪地时，身上沾染到的那些泥土！
“师尊！您…您还要我这个徒弟？！”
眼眶早已通红的罗睺，此时他仰头看向青墨的眼神里，早已满是渴望得到亲口确认的神情！
“当然了！”
“你可是为师正式收下的第一个徒弟！”
“况且你又没有做错任何事情，为师又怎么会不要你呢？！”

听到师尊并没有不要自己，罗睺此时脸上尽是疑惑不解的神色！
那这好好的，师尊又为什么，要让自己拜他人为师？！
“那师尊又为什么要…？！”
“为了让你彻底掌控始魔祖体！”
听到青墨的解释，罗睺此时是越听越糊涂了！
自己师尊有怎样的能耐，在成为青墨徒弟之后，作为弟子的罗睺就算没有亲眼见识过多少！
但是从日常的教导中，罗睺多少也能猜到一二！
（之前万道主宰隔着无尽混沌说话的声音，是整个无尽混沌和无尽域海所有生灵都能听到！）
（只是当时青墨隔着无尽混沌，给自家老头子回话的时候，他并没有让过多的人听到自己的声音！）
（所以罗睺此时并不知道，位于他眼前的师尊，就是之前那道让他颤抖不止的声音所说的:比老头子修为还高的人！）
连眼前师尊如此修为的人，都无法让自己彻底掌控始魔祖体，难道再去拜他人为师，就能让自己彻底掌控了？！
这…可能吗？！
“师尊！还是算了吧！”
“徒儿只想当您的徒弟，我是真不打算拜他人为师！”
看着罗睺摇头拒绝的模样，青墨自然知道这个徒弟内心的真实想法，不免当场摇头轻笑！
“傻蛋！这是为师特地给你找的机缘！”
“帮你彻底掌控始魔祖体，和再拜他人为师这两点，其实并不冲突！”
content_en:
Plop…!
When he heard Qing Mo asking him to become his teacher, thinking that the other person didn't want him, Luo Hu's eyes were full of panic and he immediately knelt down in front of the former!
"Master! Master!"
"Did I do something wrong? I will definitely repent and follow Master's teachings even more in the future!"
"Master! Don't want your disciples!"
The words have fallen!
I remember the little shot, Luo Hu, who was about to cry. He kowtowed to Qing Mo quickly, his tone full of pleading and trembling!
As Luo Hu's master these years, Qing Mo has been thinking about everything for his apprentice. Whether it's using or practicing, he is the best among the best!
And every time Luo Hu encountered something he didn't understand while practicing, Qing Mo would patiently help him solve his doubts and give him some pointers, even teaching him many times, for fear that he wouldn't be able to understand the essence all at once!
As a master, Qing Mo's kindness to Luo Hu was completely seen in his eyes and remembered in his heart, and he did not dare to forget it for a moment!
Now the master who treats him so well actually wants him to become his master!
For Luo Hu, this kind of thing is like the sky has fallen!
"Get up, get up!"
"Who said I don't want you as my teacher?!"
Looking at the extremely emotional Luo Hu in front of him, Qing Mo smiled slightly, then bent down and reached out to help him up, and also gently patted the dirt on his body when he was kneeling!
"Master! You...you still want me as your disciple?!"
Luo Hu, whose eyes were already red, looked up at Qing Mo with an expression longing for personal confirmation!
"Of course!"
"You are the first apprentice that my master has officially accepted!"
"Besides, you haven't done anything wrong, so why would I not want you as a teacher?!"
Hearing that the master did not abandon him, Luo Hu's face was full of confusion!
Well, that's fine, why does the master want to worship someone else as his master? !
"Then why would Master...?!"
"In order for you to completely control the ancestral body of the First Demon!"
After hearing Qing Mo's explanation, Luo Hu became more and more confused!
What kind of abilities his master has, even if Luo Hu, as a disciple, has not seen much of it with his own eyes after becoming Qing Mo's disciple!
But from the daily teachings, Luo Hu could guess a thing or two!
(The voice of the Lord of Ten Thousand Dao before speaking through the endless chaos can be heard by all the creatures in the entire endless chaos and the endless sea!)
(It’s just that when Qing Mo replied to his old man through the endless chaos, he didn’t let too many people hear his voice!)
(So Luo Hu didn’t know at this time that the master in front of him was what the voice that made him tremble said before: someone with a higher level of cultivation than the old man!)
Even a person with the master's cultivation level in front of me can't completely control the ancestral body of the First Demon. Could it be that if I worship someone else as my teacher, I can completely control it? !
Is this...possible? !
"Master! Let's forget it!"
"My disciple only wants to be your disciple. I really don't intend to accept anyone else as my teacher!"
Seeing Luo Hu shaking his head in refusal, Qing Mo naturally knew the true thoughts of this apprentice and couldn't help but shake his head and chuckle on the spot!
"Idiot! This is an opportunity that my master has specially found for you!"
"There is actually no conflict between helping you completely control the ancestral body of the First Demon and becoming a disciple of others!"
